comment: Six canned confessions the stub Extractor keyword-matches, and the seeded-extraction fallback set (flags.extraction = 'seeded'). Keywords are matched case-insensitively against the confession text.

confessions.text: I order the spicy one every time we go out because everyone expects me to, and I regret it every time.
When I eat alone I go to the counter place and order the same thing and it is the best meal of my week.
I always say I'm not hungry at the nice place because I can't really afford anything past the lunch menu.
The bun bo hue wrecks my stomach every single time. I never ordered it again and never told anyone why.
The taqueria was our place before the breakup. It's the best food in the neighborhood and I can't go back.
Everyone raves about the famous spot but I keep going back to the little grain bowl place nobody reviews.
